toolsets.name: Gaming
toolsets.description: Steam (installer from Debian contrib; Steam itself is downloaded from Valve on first start), Proton via Steam Play, GameMode, MangoHud performance overlay, Vulkan tools and 32-bit Mesa drivers.
toolsets.warning: Enables 32-bit (i386) packages, which Steam needs. Steam is proprietary software subject to Valve's Steam Subscriber Agreement.

toolsets.name: NVIDIA proprietary driver
toolsets.description: Debian's packaged NVIDIA driver (DKMS) with 32-bit libraries for Steam. Only for NVIDIA GPUs that the open-source nouveau driver handles poorly.
toolsets.warning: With Secure Boot enabled, the DKMS kernel module must be signed with a Machine Owner Key (MOK): you will be asked to create and enrol one at the next boot. SOS OS never disables Secure Boot for you. Restart after installing.

toolsets.name: Developer tools
toolsets.description: Git, GitHub CLI, Python with venv and pip, GCC, Clang, GDB, CMake, Make, OpenSSH client, Podman containers and the Kate editor with language-server support.
